# A plain CAD receipt, a customer, and a USD receivable waiting beside it.
#
# The test that uses this rewrites the receipt into the customer's USD
# prepayment — the money arrived as CAD, so the receivable credit is the only
# record of the currency owed — and re-imports it with `--strategy update`.
# The credit is a prepayment because it sits in an owner lot no invoice owns,
# and `lot_owner:` is what puts it there, so an update that drops that line
# leaves a split the same file would have made a cost basis through `--new`.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_update_strategy_respects_cost_basis.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

2026-02-01 * "To be corrected into a customer prepayment"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 137.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Income:Sales -137.00 CAD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
